subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Eight species of bear exist today.
• Three bear species can be found in North America.
• One of those species is the American black bear.
• Its scientific name is Ursus americanus.
• Another of those species is the Asian black bear.
• Its scientific name is Ursus thibetanus.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two bear species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Both the American black bear and the Asian black bear can be found in North America.
choices.B: Among the eight species of bear is the Asian black bear, which can be found in North America.
choices.C: The American black bear is referred to as Ursus americanus, while the Asian black bear is referred to as Ursus thibetanus.
choices.D: The American black bear (Ursus americanus) and the Asian black bear (Ursus thibetanus) are different species.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a similarity between the two bear species: both can be found in North America.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence emphasizes a difference between the two bear species rather than a similarity.
